newsitem.title: USA: Caribiner to file 1.88 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Caribiner to file 1.88 mln share offering.

text.p: Caribiner International Inc said Friday it planned to file with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 1,878,200 shares.
The company said it will offer 1.75 million shares and certain company managers will offer 128,200.

Caribiner, which provides business communication, training and meeting services, said its proceeds will be used to repay all outstanding bank borrowings, to make acquisitions, and to fund general corporate needs.
Caribiner also it had definitively agreed to buy Blumberg Communications Inc, which provides audio visual equipment services.
Caribiner said it will pay $16.6 million in cash and $1.4 million in Caribiner common stock and will repay $5.5 million in Blumberg debt.
Caribiner said the acquisition should close in early 1997 and expand its geographic reach and its package of business communication services.
It said Blumberg had revenues of $42 million in the fiscal year ended last May.
